visual.description: Two bar chart groups stacked vertically. Group 1: 'Formaldehyde Content (mg/kg)' — Eco-friendly 10.4 (Accent Pink) vs Conventional 8.23 (Accent Blue). Eco-friendly bar is longer — paradox highlighted with small '↑ 26% more' annotation. Group 2: 'Formaldehyde Emission (ug/m2/h)' — Unwashed 107 (Negative Red) vs Washed 42 (Positive Green). '−61%' annotation on washed bar. Title: 'The Eco-Friendly Paradox'. Bars grow with 6-frame stagger.

notes: Key paradox scene — eco-friendly having MORE formaldehyde is the surprise. Group 1 bars should complete first, hold for the voiceover beat, then Group 2 appears. The wash comparison uses Positive/Negative colors from the brand guide. Consider composite-phases for the two chart groups if timing requires separate reveals.
